eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Spokane, WA; at 5:59 PM on JUL 31, 2026 Effective until 8:59 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Extreme Fire Weather: The National Weather Service has issued a Red Flag Warning Spokane County for Saturday, August 1 from 11 am to 11 pm. This means warm temperatures, low relative humidity and high winds could lead to extreme fire behavior. This is considered an Extreme Fire Weather day. Be alert for new fire starts and be prepared to evacuate immediately if a wildfire breaks out.
